import RNA, random

pairs = [(8,13),(7,14),(28,32),(27,33),(26,34),(24,37),(21,40),(19,43),(18,44),(17,45),(51,56),(48,59),(64,69),(61,72),(79,84),(78,85),(4,88),(1,91),(0,92)]

 (9,12):['GAAA','UUCG','GCAA','CUUG'],

 (80,83):['GAAA','UUCG','GCAA','CUUG'],
}
comp={'G':'C','C':'G','A':'U','U':'A'}
def build(pchoices, pairtypes):
    seq=list('A'*93)
    for (i,j),pt in zip(pairs,pairtypes):
        if pt==0: seq[i]='G';seq[j]='C'
        elif pt==1: seq[i]='C';seq[j]='G'
        elif pt==2: seq[i]='A';seq[j]='U'
        else: seq[i]='U';seq[j]='A'
    for (a,b),ch in zip([(9,12),(29,31),(52,55),(65,68),(80,83)], pchoices):
        s=ch
        k=a
        for c in s:
            seq[k]=c;k+=1
    return ''.join(seq)

best=None;bestd=999
random.seed(1)
import itertools
# sample
lcaps=[v for v in loop_pos.values()]
cnt=0

print(best)
